label: Test the personal origin interpretation of a single source's self-expression and love
summary: Tested an analyst reconstruction of the immanent Word and Love account. Subsistence of the three roles in one numerical esse plus lifting their order to irreflexive personal origins and either Word participation or incompatible passive receptions gives a genuinely distinguished triad. A separate inventory exhausts the personal bearers. A single subject of actual grounded self-apprehension and willing its own good meets the weaker interpretation. A two-person profile keeps role subsistence and real opposition while co-receiving the two modes. Two exhaustive triads witness the two sufficient profiles. The iterated-generation model preserves the lower bound, classified bearers, unique underived source and unique spirated recipient while adding another begotten bearer. Injective identification of persons by common esse contradicts the lower bound. See docs/notes/immanent-origins.md for the overall provisional assessment, strongest positive warrant, surviving alternatives and revision conditions. The preparation concerns candidate clauses of the whole-article Creed records only.
blocker: Knowledge, truth of self-expression and love do not supply an applicable subsisting-person or origin-lifting bridge. The positive interpretation still needs a reason why a perfect immanent expression is personally constituted by a real reference of origin rather than the transparent self-expression of one subject. Word/Love separation, the uniqueness and exhaustiveness of personal receptive modes, one common spirating principle, the divine interpretation of a numerically common esse, and identification with Creed referents require further evidence. The existing whole-article predicates take a separate case signature.
